scope: DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md task 3.8 slice 1: Catch2 unit suite and llvm-cov coverage pins for rta/ at the C++17 pin (gate G3.1, VAL-016).

catch2.origin: Fetched by CMake FetchContent from rta/CMakeLists.txt; the same pinned artifact is used by sim/fmi/master (record SNDEV/docs/impl-2026-11-05-task27-slice1-thermal-fmu.md and sim/SOUP.md).
catch2.offlineRebuild: FetchContent verifies the SHA-256 on every fetch and caches the sources under <build>/_deps. A rebuild without network works against a populated build tree with -DFETCHCONTENT_FULLY_DISCONNECTED=ON, or with a vendored copy passed as -DFETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_CATCH2=<path>.

llvmToolchain.components: clang++, clang, llvm-profdata, llvm-cov (profdata mode and gcov mode)
llvmToolchain.origin: Official LLVM 19.1.5 release binary, downloaded and extracted with tar to a user path (no elevation, not added to PATH). Same LLVM version as the clang-tidy pin in vv/static-analysis/pins.json.

coverage.evidenceLane: host windows: clang++ 19.1.5 with -fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping at CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17, CTest run under LLVM_PROFILE_FILE, llvm-profdata 19.1.5 merge, llvm-cov 19.1.5 report and export (rta/tests/coverage.ps1)
coverage.ciLaneNote: The rta-tests job on ubuntu-24.04 builds rta/ and runs the same CTest suite with the image toolchain and produces no coverage evidence; the host lane owns the measured numbers.
coverage.thirdPartyExclusion: llvm-cov -ignore-filename-regex 'catch2|_deps[\/]|MSVC[\/]14' keeps the report to rta/ sources
coverage.evaluatedAndDropped: The gcov-format route (clang --coverage plus gcovr 8.8 over llvm-cov gcov) was evaluated on 2026-11-13 and dropped: for the Catch2-linked translation units the .gcno file table omits the primary .cpp path (observed with clang 19.1.5), so that report missed three rta/tests files. gcovr 8.8 stays installed on the host but is not part of the pinned check set.
coverage.mcdcCandidateNote: llvm-cov 19.1.5 already exposes --show-branch-summary and --show-mcdc-summary on report; the MC/DC evaluation itself is the task 3.8 work item under deviation SA-004.

mcdc.status: work item, not verified in this slice
mcdc.candidate: Clang 19 or newer llvm-cov MC/DC reporting (DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md Section 5.2)
